about: Reviewed USA -> Japanese (SLPS-25815, Sparking! Meteor VER 1.01) native values for build_pal_map.py --region jpn. overrides win over the research mapper; notes say why (side-by-side disassembly of both executables). An override equal to the mapper value records a reviewed hook site inside a function the Japanese executable changed. The Japanese executable is a USA-shaped build: gp, .lit4/.sdata/.sbss/.scommon/.bss and the overlay base keep their USA addresses; code shifts in constant-delta runs; most changed functions differ only in native actor-flag numbers (USA flags 147..184 are one lower, 186..316 two lower; native_map.FLAG) and register allocation.

notes.0x2614b0: native_menu_services NARRATION entry hook: JP 2612D8 plays the menu voice without the USA voice-language test (USA lw v1,-0x4fe4(gp); +0x1608 & 1 picks one of two voice banks). The hook only decides by caller whether to mute.
